correctness.rationale: For S in complete multipartite K_(n_i), each unselected vertex in part i has exactly s-s_i neighbors in S, yielding the iff part occupancy inequalities. If support S meets at least two parts, N(S)=V and no isolates; if S is a single full part, N(S)=V\V_i has no isolates iff r≥3, explaining the bipartite exclusion. Product of binomial occupancy polynomials counts all feasible sizes after subtracting full one-part sets for r=2. Minimal feasible patterns yield gamma=N for a bipartite star, 3 for bipartite min part 2, 4 for larger bipartite sizes, and 2 or 3 as stated for r≥3. Independently evaluated all literal subsets on 10 multipartite profiles with exact criterion and gamma agreement; general result is symbolic.

value.rationale: An exact all-set cardinality enumerator is a natural graph invariant in the published neighborhood-total-2-domination framework. It classifies every feasible set for arbitrary complete multipartite part sizes, extending previously known minimum values; polynomial coefficients are potentially reusable without rerunning exhaustive search.

limitations: The claim is only for connected complete multipartite graphs, not arbitrary graphs or minimal dominating sets.
Founding paper Sivagnanam 2014 full text unavailable due to VPN disconnect; earlier special-case gamma values are not novel.
Finite enumeration is a regression check, not a proof of all part sizes.
